name: sdd-planner
description: Plan software with Software Design Descriptions (IEEE 1016): write one section at a time, review on a claude.ai page, publish with optional Notion sync

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Shown in each new SDD's title block. Leave empty for none.

author.title: Author name
author.description: Your name on each new SDD and on the Revision History rows you add. Leave empty and Claude asks for it when you start an SDD.

notion_data_source_id.title: Notion data source ID
notion_data_source_id.description: The Notion database (data source) that new SDD pages go into. Leave empty to keep Notion sync off.

notion_title_property.title: Notion title property
notion_title_property.description: The database's title property. Empty means Name.

notion_title_prefix.title: Page title prefix
notion_title_prefix.description: Put before each page title, followed by a space, for example SDD:

notion_status_property.title: Notion status property
notion_status_property.description: A status property to set on each page. Empty means no status is set.

notion_status_draft.title: Status while drafting
notion_status_draft.description: The status value for a draft, for example Doing.

notion_status_published.title: Status once published
notion_status_published.description: The status value after /sdd-planner:publish, for example Done.

notion_tags_property.title: Notion tags property
notion_tags_property.description: A multi-select property for the SDD's tags. Empty means no tags are set.

notion_tags.title: Tag options
notion_tags.description: The database's tag options Claude may pick from, separated by commas.

notion_fixed_properties.title: Fixed properties
notion_fixed_properties.description: Properties set on every page, as Name=Value pairs separated by commas, for example Category=Document.

notion_heading_marks.title: Heading marks
notion_heading_marks.description: Three marks put before level 1, 2 and 3 headings on the page, separated by spaces. Empty means plain headings.

notion_page_icon.title: Page icon
notion_page_icon.description: An emoji for the page icon. Empty means none.
